name: Create a coherent artistic system
short_description: Create and sustain a distinctive system of form, constraints, and variation across at least 20 finished works.
self_assessment: I can create 20 works within one coherent artistic system without help and defend every deliberate variation.
description: Create and sustain a distinctive system of form, constraints, and variation across at least 20 finished works. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Develop 20 related works across two media
